description: mlp-html/1 sanitization corpus. Outputs generated by the prototype reference sanitizer; conformance comparison is parsed-tree equality, not byte equality. Manifest for all cases contains exactly the TV-001 object URN.

cases.name: benign_rich
cases.notes: Fully conformant body passes essentially unchanged.

cases.name: script_drop
cases.notes: script is on the drop-subtree list.

cases.name: tracking_pixel
cases.notes: External src: embed elements with non-Manifest src are removed entirely.

cases.name: js_href
cases.notes: Disallowed scheme: href stripped, text preserved.

cases.name: event_attr
cases.notes: Event attributes are not in any allowlist.

cases.name: urn_not_in_manifest
cases.notes: Syntactically valid urn:mlet absent from the Manifest: removed (3.2.3).

cases.name: css_url_smuggle
cases.notes: No-functional-notation grammar drops the url() declaration; others survive.

cases.name: svg_mxss
cases.notes: Foreign content (svg/math) is dropped with its subtree.

cases.name: fragment_nav
cases.notes: Fragment navigation within the Medialet is preserved.

cases.name: position_overlay
cases.notes: position/top are not allowlisted properties; color survives.

cases.name: display_none_hiding
cases.notes: display value restricted to block|inline|inline-block|flex; none dropped.

cases.name: unwrap_unknown
cases.notes: Unknown-but-harmless elements are unwrapped, content preserved.

cases.name: data_uri
cases.notes: data: is not urn:mlet:; element removed.
